title: Hi-Light R6 titanium road frame
notes: Exact R6 frameset page lists titanium frame identity, carbon fork, BSA threaded bottom bracket, internal routing, mechanical/electronic compatibility, flat-mount brakes, 27.2 mm seatpost, 100×12 / 142×12 thru-axles, ETRTO 35-622 / 700×35C maximum and S–XXL plus custom sizing. It does not establish the R6 105 AL complete-bike BOM or weight.
